title: Third Moment Bound from the Third Norm
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a measurable space, let $Z:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ belong to $L^3(\mu)$, and let $B\ge 0$. If $N_3(Z)^2\le B$, where $N_3$ is the real-valued random-variable norm, then $\int_\Omega |Z(\omega)|^3\,d\mu(\omega)\le B^{3/2}$.
hypotheses_covered: The squared real-valued norm at exponent $3$ satisfies $N_3(Z)^2\le B$
